# RC43 — Indent or outdent current line or selected lines

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc >` / `core.indent-lines` / `Indent Line/Selection`.
- Added `Esc <` / `core.outdent-lines` / `Outdent Line/Selection`.
- With no selection, the commands indent or outdent the current logical line.
- With a selection, the commands indent or outdent the full affected logical-line range.
- Indent uses the configured indentation style and tab width. Outdent removes one leading tab or up to one configured space-indent unit per changed line.
- Cursor and selection positions are adjusted to stay coherent with the changed text.
- The operation is one dirty undoable edit when it changes text, reports a safe no-op when nothing can be outdented, and read-only IDE views refuse it.
- Compact help, action footer, command palette, keymap reference, README, and iPad QA now expose the route.
